## Tips & gotchas

- Use a 'C' notch on braces if light clearance is tight after fabrication. [t1619]
- [Partial] Look for an aggressive design with holes cut at the front, though this may require custom templates. [t1619]
- Consider having the fabricator use thicker tube stock if standard width feels too narrow. [t1619]
- [Partial] Use Duplicator bed armor or similar coating, applying it by rolling rather than brushing to avoid texture issues. [t1619]
- [Partial] Consider using Rust-Oleum Pro Flat Black on roof racks as a cost-effective alternative that holds up well. [t1619]
- [Partial] Specify thicker tube stock for the hitch area if extra strength is desired over standard width. [t1619]
- [Partial] Ensure side marker lights fit within custom-cut sections on the bumper sides. [t1619]
- Look for designs similar to Brian's (Schrock) style if available, as they offer specific utility features. [t1619]
- Consider this option when selling other accessories like guitar cases or roof racks. [t1619]
- Consider painting the top bar over the winch area silver to complement blacked-out grills. [t1619]
- Use rattle cans for testing color matches before committing to full coverage. [t1619]
- [Partial] Ensure the design allows for easy recognition as RLC's unique style rather than generic options. [t1619]
- Plan to have the vehicle available at least two full days for fabrication and fitting adjustments. [t1619]
- If mounting lights before fabrication, ask the builder to wait until arrival to weld tabs on for better alignment. [t1619]
- Expect spacing to be an inch or two wider than stock for improved clearance. [t1619]
- Note that holes may have been cut before bracing was added, requiring minor 'C' notching later. [t1619]
- Use Duplicolor Bed Armor or similar products that are easy to prep and touch up. [t1619]
- [Partial] Roll the product on instead of brushing it to achieve a smoother, more uniform finish. [t1619]
- [Partial] Ensure the design accommodates stock side marker lights without modification. [t1619]
- [Partial] Look for an aggressive look that features holes cut at the front of the bumper. [t1619]
